# Project Agent Toolkit agent brief

Task routing is defined by [`.agent-governance.json`](../.agent-governance.json). Match the
request and likely changed paths, then read every returned authority
completely. Do not load unrelated policy just in case.

## Authority order

1. [System boundaries and design decisions](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
2. [Non-negotiable repository constraints](../RULES.md)
3. [How work is planned, changed, verified, and handed off](../docs/WORKFLOW.md)
4. [Current objective, verified state, and next action](../PROGRESS.md)

The user's current request controls the task. Lower authorities do not
silently override higher ones.

## Working contract

- Inspect relevant implementation and version-control state before editing.
- Preserve unrelated user changes.
- Decide capability ownership before placing code or policy.
- Make the smallest coherent change that achieves the requested outcome.
- Validate in proportion to risk and report only current evidence.
- Planned, incomplete, stale, or unrun work is not complete.
